title: Euler’s Criterion for the Quadratic Residue Symbol
statement: Let $p$ be an odd prime and let $A$ be a natural number. Define the quadratic residue symbol modulo $p$ to be $0$ when $A$ is not coprime to $p$, $1$ when the residue of $A$ modulo $p$ is a square, and $-1$ otherwise. Its value modulo $p$ equals $A^{(p-1)/2}$ modulo $p$.
